purpose: Freeze a single primary study-held-out estimand for the T195 common-target portability route, assign T197/T198/T203/T209 to explicit secondary roles, and audit target availability, missingness denominators and project-wide multiplicity without refitting any model or pooling non-exchangeable routes.

primary_estimand.analysis_population: The exact nine-accession intersection frozen before T195 from the three audited paper-linked source maps.

target_universe.selection_rule: finite strictly positive source value in the pre-frozen common-target registry
target_universe.selection_timing: frozen before model fitting and before outer-fold evaluation

primary_estimand.outer_split: leave-one-laboratory-or-source-anchor-out; held-out anchor is excluded from target membership, alpha selection and model selection
primary_estimand.biological_independence_status: not_resolved_for_all_routes; laboratory anchors are not independent biological cohorts
primary_estimand.prediction_row: one source-local rank-percentile observation for one frozen canonical accession
primary_estimand.outcome: arithmetic mean of within-batch Spearman correlations over held-out measurement batches within each outer fold
primary_estimand.aggregation: report each outer-fold effect and interval separately; no pooled effect across non-exchangeable laboratory/source anchors
primary_estimand.nested_selection: leave-one-measurement-batch-out within outer development anchors; alpha grid [0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0]; smallest-alpha tie break
primary_estimand.uncertainty: percentile bootstrap over held-out measurement batches, 2,000 resamples per fold and paired contrast
primary_estimand.negative_control: within-development-measurement-batch target permutation; observed nested-selected alpha held fixed for T195

route_roles.pooling: primary route only; effects remain fold-specific
never counted as additional independent studies

availability_policy.denominator: all candidate source-mapped rows, batches, biological units and target sets exposed by the relevant frozen receipt before qualification
availability_policy.selection_bias_status: potentially informative source availability remains; threshold sensitivity does not identify MNAR
availability_policy.correction_status: no imputation, IPW or MNAR correction is claimed unless a future amendment supplies the required covariates

missingness_policy.source_na: retain as AUTHOR_NA and exclude from rank/model scoring; no imputation
missingness_policy.source_zero: retain as AUTHOR_EXPLICIT_ZERO and exclude from rank/model scoring; no imputation
missingness_policy.interpretation: descriptive denominator and retention audit; no MAR, MCAR or MNAR assumption

primary_family.p_value: not estimated; report effect sizes and cluster intervals only
primary_family.reason: current evidence is exploratory and biological/study-level independence is unresolved

quality_control_family.adjustment: Holm step-down across the three outer-fold QC p-values
quality_control_family.claim_status: QC calibration only; not evidence of a scientific effect

secondary_family.reporting: effect sizes, intervals, denominators and direction only

effective_n_policy.rule: reported biological-unit count is not effective n and measurement-batch count is not biological n
effective_n_policy.T195_T197: donor-level effective n unresolved; report measurement-batch count and source/laboratory anchor count
effective_n_policy.T198: 141 biological units at primary threshold 10; not cross-study replication n
effective_n_policy.T203: 45 reported measurement batches; biological n not inferred from this receipt
effective_n_policy.T209: 60 paper-anchored patient clusters; not cross-study replication n

claim_boundary: T217 establishes a pre-registered role hierarchy and audits denominators, selection and multiplicity for paper-derived exploratory analyses. It does not create independent biological validation, a pooled confirmatory effect, effective cross-study n, a protected lockbox, a no-author reproduction, external adoption, DOI archival evidence or scientific submission readiness.
